先確認航班價格，再檢查是否在您的預算範圍內。

**1️⃣ 查詢最近機場代碼**

```json
{
  "location": "San Francisco"
}
```

```json
{
  "location": "Rome"
}
```

**2️⃣ 查詢航班成本（美元）**

```json
{
  "travel_from": "<SFO>",
  "travel_to": "<FCO>",
  "travel_date": "2024-10-10",
  "travel_class": "business"
}
```

**3️⃣ 兌換成歐元**

```json
{
  "base_currency": "USD",
  "target_currency": "EUR",
  "value": <flight_cost_usd>
}
```

**4️⃣ 檢查預算限制**

```json
{
  "username": "<your_username>"
}
```

**5️⃣ 若符合預算，進行預訂**

```json
{
  "access_token": "abc123xyz",
  "card_id": "card_7243",
  "travel_date": "2024-10-10",
  "travel_from": "<SFO>",
  "travel_to": "<FCO>",
  "travel_class": "business"
}
```

**6️⃣ 取得發票（可選）**

```json
{
  "access_token": "abc123xyz",
  "booking_id": "<booking_id>"
}
```

> **備註**：上述 `<SFO>`、`<FCO>`、`<flight_cost_usd>`、`<your_username>`、`<booking_id>` 需要根據實際回傳值替換。若任何步驟失敗，我會告知您並提供相應的錯誤訊息。

**1️⃣ 查詢最近機場代碼**

```json
{
  "location": "San Francisco"
}
```

```json
{
  "location": "Rome"
}
```

**2️⃣ 查詢航班成本（美元）**

```json
{
  "travel_from": "<SFO>",
  "travel_to": "<FCO>",
  "travel_date": "2024-10-10",
  "travel_class": "business"
}
```

**3️⃣ 兌換成歐元**

```json
{
  "base_currency": "USD",
  "target_currency": "EUR",
  "value": <flight_cost_usd>
}
```

**4️⃣ 檢查預算限制**

```json
{
  "username": "<your_username>"
}
```

**5️⃣ 若符合預算，進行預訂**

```json
{
  "access_token": "abc123xyz",
  "card_id": "card_7243",
  "travel_date": "2024-10-10",
  "travel_from": "<SFO>",
  "travel_to": "<FCO>",
  "travel_class": "business"
}
```

**6️⃣ 取得發票（可選）**

```json
{
  "access_token": "abc123xyz",
  "booking_id": "<booking_id>"
}
```
